reason: They want the item price and their fee paid up front, to a name I have never heard of, and then I wait two or three weeks hoping something shows up. I only pay when the thing is in my hand, so this is a no for me.
objection: Paying 30,000 or 40,000 dinars in advance by Zain Cash to a new page, and if they disappear my money is gone. A refund promise from someone I don't know means nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery for everything, or a cousin or neighbour who has already received several orders from them without problems.
